'''Electric Mining Rig Mk II''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|Must be connected to the power grid with adequate power to work. This mining rig can mine Ferrium Ore and other minerals.|The Mk II upgrade of the electric mining rig features improved drill bit hardness, improved performance in rugged environment, and deeper mining capabilities.}}
==Usage==
Must be connected to the power grid with adequate power to work. This mining rig can mine [[Ferrium Ore]] and other minerals.

Despite using more power, this mining rig does not produce resources any faster and thus the [[Electric Mining Rig]] should still be used for [[Originium Ore]] and [[Amethyst Ore]].
*Power Use : 10

==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Basic AIC Plan|Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC III - Mining III]]
